notes.title: Ordering information
notes.text: Confirm size, material, property class, finish, quantity and delivery requirements in your RFQ.

notes.title: Assembly notes
notes.text: Match the countersink to the screw head. Use the specified driver size and application-specific tightening instructions.

detail.availability: Sizes in the standard are reference information. Availability and lead time are confirmed with your quotation.

standards.title: ISO 10642:2026
standards.description: Hexagon socket countersunk head screws with reduced loadability.

notes.title: Standard scope
notes.text: The standard covers steel and stainless steel screws with metric coarse threads from M2 to M20.

notes.title: Reduced loadability
notes.text: The countersunk head and socket geometry reduce loadability. Check the specified property class and the application requirements.

notes.title: DIN 7991 reference
notes.text: DIN 7991 is a withdrawn reference. Verify dimensions and application suitability before substituting ISO 10642.
